### RA20-Q-01 decisions — re-affirmed by me directly (resolves RAV-01)
This comment is the original, verbatim record of these decisions. It replaces the earlier summarized source.

1. **Urgency values:** Critical, High, Medium, Low. They match the Ticket.Priority allowed values but are a separate business attribute. No automatic or implicit mapping between urgency and priority.
2. **Read/review scope:**
   - Support Agent: only tickets currently assigned to them.
   - Support Manager: tickets in their currently assigned teams, including team-queued tickets with no individual Agent.
   - Tenant Admin: any ticket in their own tenant.
   - Platform Admin: no individual ticket urgency access or review.
   - Authorization is revalidated on every read, review, accept, or override.
3. **Review behavior:**
   - Accept sets `ReviewedUrgency = SuggestedUrgency`; override sets `ReviewedUrgency` to the selected allowed value.
   - `SuggestedUrgency` is preserved unchanged, and ReviewedBy/ReviewedAt are recorded.
   - Urgency review never changes `Ticket.Priority`; any Priority change uses FR-TM-14.

I confirm that v1.11 at the SHA-256 above reflects these decisions accurately.

### Approval decision
I approve SupportIQ Product Requirement v1.11 at the exact SHA-256 above.

Scope: this approves only the requirement. It does **not** start Implementation Planning. Planning needs its own explicit process initiation. Section 17 items (model/region, token/cost limits, email provider, timeout/retry) remain deferred, as stated in v1.11.
approved_decisions: Urgency values are Critical, High, Medium, Low; they share the Ticket.Priority value set but remain a separate attribute with no mapping.

Support Agent: currently assigned tickets; Support Manager: currently assigned teams including team-queued tickets; Tenant Admin: own tenant; Platform Admin: no individual ticket urgency access or review; revalidate authorization on read/review/accept/override.

Acceptance copies SuggestedUrgency to ReviewedUrgency; override stores the selected valid value; preserve SuggestedUrgency and reviewer/time; urgency review never changes Ticket.Priority; Priority changes use FR-TM-14.
conditions: Approval applies only to the exact v1.11 bytes above.
Approval does not start Implementation Planning; planning requires separate explicit process initiation.
